risks.risk: Item mismatch: photos appear to be a motorcycle engine/frame assembly, not a GMC Sierra V8 2008–2015 gearbox.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the gearbox label/part number and the full unit (bellhousing/gearcase) with model/fitment markings; plus a photo of the exact item being sold matching the seller’s description.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-matching/uncertain part (worst case: not the gearbox claimed), treating it as scrap/for-parts value until identity is proven.

risks.risk: Incomplete or heavily disassembled unit: many parts are missing/removed, so completeness and compatibility are uncertain.
risks.proof: A full set of photos showing the complete assembled gearbox/engine with all external components present (starter/alternator/ECU-CDI or gearbox sensors as applicable) and no missing housings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/for-parts due to missing components.

risks.risk: Unknown mechanical condition (no proof of running, compression, or internal damage).
risks.proof: Short video of the unit running under load (or at minimum a start test) plus a compression/leak-down test screenshot/record if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: may be defective).

risks.risk: Rust/cracks/overheating damage not fully verifiable from the single angle.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of critical areas (housing seams, mounting points, gearcase surfaces, and any heat-stained zones) in good lighting.

risks.risk: Wrong fitment risk: even if it is a gearbox, compatibility with the claimed GMC Sierra V8 years/engine variant is not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of the gearbox identification plate/part number and a fitment chart or VIN/engine code confirmation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as uncertain fitment (worst case: may not fit).

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the exact gearbox unit being sold (front/back, full assembly) and any identification plate/part number.
Provide a running/start video (or test report) showing it works and confirming “no knock” audibly.
Show proof of provenance (import documents or markings) if claiming “Tokunbo direct from Belgium.”
Confirm fitment for GMC Sierra V8 2008–2015 with part number and/or VIN/engine code match.
response.reason: The witness photos do not clearly match the seller’s claim of a GMC Sierra V8 gearbox; they show a motorcycle engine/frame assembly with missing/uncertain completeness. Without identity and working-test proof, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
